kind: replicated descriptive development comparison (development evidence only; no test, no biological claim)
question: For mdCATH domain 1ha8A00, which per-window local Calpha geometries differ between 320 K and 348 K beyond replica-to-replica variation within a temperature?

dataset.source: mdCATH (Mirarchi, Giorgino, De Fabritiis, Sci. Data 2024, doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04140-z), pinned revision 5e3ed8aec62b689e01751db16275fdcdbc39e47f; CC BY 4.0
dataset.replica_independence: all replicas start from one equilibrated configuration (velocities differ); they measure reproducibility given that start, not independent starting conditions
exposure_history: WP-D held-out runner development validation (wpd_heldout_runner_dev_validation.json; 320/0, 320/1, 348/0, 348/1; geometric retrieval)
EB-1 engineering benchmark workload D2 (320 K, replicas 0 and 1; timing and correctness)
CMP-1 competitive evaluation workload R3_D2 (Calpha RMSD accuracy and timing)
No previous per-window distribution comparison between temperatures on this domain
Not part of the protected WP-D held-out cohort, which is not touched

sampling.common_frame_range: source frames 0-429 (430 frames; the shortest replica has 430)
sampling.initial_frame_exclusion: frames 0-42 (first 10 % of the common range, the WP-D/EB-1 burn-in convention), fixed before scoring
sampling.time: files store no timestamps; inferred time = source frame index x 1 ns (dataset paper), labelled INFERRED
sampling.frame_indices: source frame indices preserved in all outputs

pipeline_policies.pbc: make_whole_sequential (stored box, nm x 10, applied to all frames)

d_i_i2.window: 3 residues: Calpha(i-1)-Calpha(i+1), equal-information baseline for kappa

d_i_i3.window: 4 residues: Calpha(i-1)-Calpha(i+2), equal-information baseline for tau

configurations.rule: primary fixed in advance; sensitivity reported, never used for selection

replica_level_analysis.unit: replica (one histogram per replica and window)
replica_level_analysis.pairs: within 320: 10; within 348: 10; between: 25. Pairwise distances share replicas and are treated as dependent; no test, no p-value

categories.consistent: every between-temperature pair distance exceeds every within-temperature pair distance
categories.replica_dependent: not consistent with all replicas, but consistent when one specific replica is left out (listed)
categories.inconclusive: neither; no complete separation from replica-to-replica variation at 5 replicas per temperature (not evidence of no difference)

replica_level_analysis.leave_one_replica_out: 10 subsets (one replica removed from either temperature): category membership and the range of the pooled 320-vs-348 distance
replica_level_analysis.pooled: JS distance between pooled 320 K and pooled 348 K histograms, reported separately from replica-pair distances
replica_level_analysis.matched_observations: a window enters a channel pair only if every used frame is valid in every replica for both channels

physics_notes: kappa and the i->i+2 distance are near-deterministic functions of each other when bond lengths are nearly constant
the i->i+3 distance cannot distinguish tau from -tau
marginal per-window distributions can miss changes in joint relationships
320 K vs 348 K is a simulation-condition contrast, not a measured biological endpoint

resource_budget.note: 51-residue domain; engineering budget, not a performance target
